Software Engineer, Backend (New Grad)
Larkspur Analytics
Location: Portland, OR (Hybrid, 3 days in office)

About Larkspur
Larkspur builds forecasting tools for regional grocers. We are a team of 40 engineers.

What you'll do
- Build REST APIs in Node and Python that serve forecasts to store managers
- Design PostgreSQL schemas and tune slow queries
- Own on-call for the services you ship, with a mentor

Requirements:
- BS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience
- 1+ years of professional software engineering experience
- Experience with Python or Go
- 2+ years of SQL, ideally Postgres
- Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes

Nice to have
- Experience with Kafka or RabbitMQ
- MariaDB in production
- Exposure to Zorblang or other niche DSLs

Benefits
- Health, dental and vision from day one
- 401(k) match

Larkspur is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States.
